evidencePolicy.rule: No issue closes without machine-emitted evidence: a verifier run at a pinned commit, with can-fail proof (dedicated negatives or a fully-caught mutant set), stamped with the current commit and relevant working-tree state.
evidencePolicy.commitStamps: every evidence JSON carries currentCommit; a cell goes stale when its relevant files changed after that commit
evidencePolicy.mutationProofs: every verifier proves its suite CAN FAIL via negative cases or caught mutants
